cards.card: CB Mastercard ou CB Visa à débit différé

note: Crédit Mutuel de Maine-Anjou et Basse-Normandie's fee information document for the Eurocompte Confort (1 January 2026): its international deferred-debit card, a CB Mastercard or CB Visa whose month's spending the bank takes from the account at once, costs 44.40 euros a year. Crédit Mutuel's regional federations each set their own prices; this is one federation's.
